blocks.text: Hollywood star and humanitarian Angelina Jolie is now in the Philippines for the 2026 Asean Inclusive Growth Summit where she will participate as one of the speakers. The American actress was welcomed by Filipino fans at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport (Naia) on Tuesday morning, Nov. 10. Videos of Jolie at the airport were shared by netizens including fan account @lyntwig_ on X.
